notes: Needs PiG 0.7.0 or later (Common Lisp extensions first ship in 0.7.0). Pigpen builds it on PiG 0.7.0.

Not bundled: Autolith (https://autolith.rocks, by Lambda Symbolics, ISC) must be installed and on PATH (nix run github:lambda-symbolics/autolith), SBCL 2.6.9 must be available to PiG (pig setup shows what is missing; PIG_SBCL names another executable), and Autolith needs its own model login.

The extension is Lisp and runs in a cached SBCL image that PiG builds at first load; it is not fused into the Binary. An empty Go factory (fuse-anchor, no tools or hooks) is the one fused member, because PiG refuses a Binary build with nothing to fuse. The Binary is a static build (CGO_ENABLED=0 by default) that ships only the Go and Lisp extension runtimes, but PiG 0.7.0 builds it without the Lisp cell and the Binary stops at startup (see the README), so run the Piglet from source.
Autolith by Lambda Symbolics, autolith.rocks; no endorsement implied.

The manifest lists five build targets, but only linux/amd64 has been built and run; linux/arm64, darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64 and windows/amd64 are listed in the manifest and compile-checked only, so no platform is a support claim.
